title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2014-4137 located at 506 East Westminster Avenue, westerly of 6th Avenue.
text:
[Council File 26-1649; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2014-4137 located at 506 East Westminster Avenue, westerly of 6th Avenue.
Recommendation for Council action:
APPROVE the final map of Parcel Map L.A. No. 2014-4137 located at 506 East Westminster Avenue and accompanying Subdivision Improvement Agreement and Contract with security documents.
Owner: 506 Westminster LLC (A)(O); Surveyor: Nick Kazemi
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that the subdivider has paid a fee of $9,064.00 for the processing of this final parcel map pursuant to Section 19.02(B)(3) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code. No additional City funds are needed.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council approves the final parcel map for a subdivision at 506 East Westminster Avenue in Council District 11, along with its subdivision improvement agreement and security documents.
